page.layout: One engraved portrait plate: an oval inscription frame around the portrait, with engraver's credits at the bottom corners of the plate; below the plate, a block of verse in italic, ending with a signature line at right.

main_text.l: PIERIVS WINSEMIVS, I.C. Illustr. Ordinum Frisiae Historiogr. ac Eloquent. & Historiar. Professor Celeberrimus.

l.i: Posteritas venerare Virum qui hoc cingitur ære:
Ille fuit Doctus, Facilis, Gravis, atqʼ Disertus,
Qualibet Ars toto vix uni addiscitur ævo:
Os, Oculi, Facies, Sensus, Miracula ponunt:
Fama per Historias non moritura viget.

page.notes: Engraved oval portrait of a bearded man with a large lace ruff, dark costume and a chain or cord at the chest. The inscription runs around the oval; the lower-left and lower-right credits are small italic engraver's lines. The Roman date is printed as "clɔ IↄCXLIV" in the old form, transcribed as MDCXLIV. The verse lines are set in a script-like italic type; the word "WINSEMIUS" and the signature are in small capitals. Some ink specks and spots on the scan are not printed text.
